identifier.why: the bundle id owns the macOS permissions, the app data folder and the login item; a change orphans all of them

productName.why: the .app name; the updater and the DMG layout expect it

bundle.targets.why: the Mac ships an .app (updater archive) and a .dmg, nothing else

bundle.macOS.why: hardened runtime, entitlements, signing identity and the DMG layout decide how macOS treats the app

bundle.createUpdaterArtifacts.why: without it no .app.tar.gz and no updater signature are built, so the Mac cannot update

bundle.externalBin.why: the meetings helper is the only extra executable the Mac bundle carries

app.macOSPrivateApi.why: the transparent recording overlay needs the private API

plugins.updater.pubkey.why: installed apps only accept updates signed by this key

plugins.updater.endpoints.why: installed Macs read this feed; moving it strands every installed app

src-tauri/Entitlements.plist.why: entitlements are part of the signature: a change alters what macOS grants and can reset permissions on update

src-tauri/Info.plist.why: usage descriptions and bundle keys that the permission prompts and Launch Services read

build.yml.why: the release job reads the signing secrets from the protected environment
a signing input of the Mac build: APPLE_CERTIFICATE
a signing input of the Mac build: MACOS_CERT_P12_BASE64
a signing input of the Mac build: MACOS_SIGNING_IDENTITY
a signing input of the Mac build: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY
the stable-certificate path keeps the designated requirement the same across releases, so permissions survive updates

build.yml.text: - name: Refuse to release without a signing certificate
build.yml.why: a release must never be signed ad hoc
the stable signing path the releases use
a missing dylib makes the app die at launch

release.yml.why: only the protected environment may hold the signing secrets
the Mac jobs call the shared build workflow
a release is always built signed
a signing secret the release passes to the Mac build: APPLE_CERTIFICATE
a signing secret the release passes to the Mac build: MACOS_CERT_P12_BASE64
a signing secret the release passes to the Mac build: MACOS_SIGNING_IDENTITY
a signing secret the release passes to the Mac build: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY
the release becomes Latest, which is what the update feed URL resolves to
